The measures include (1) initiating rulemaking to close the “adequate provision” requirement, which permits drug manufacturers to include a general statement of risk alongside a webpage or publication and 1-800 number to access the full product labeling, (2) aggressive deployment of its available enforcement tools, including artificial intelligence and other technology-enabled tools to monitor drug ads for DTC violations, and (3) expanded oversight of prescription drug advertising on social media.
